h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Uluberia

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Uluberia

items.pText: For a school or factory colony in Uluberia, the question that matters a year after installation is whom to call when a swing chain wears or a bolt works loose. FunPlay Systems has a separate after-sales team for this, and dealers in eastern India. We make outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,610 km away, and send it to Uluberia by road.

Uluberia is an industrial town on the west bank of the Hooghly in Howrah district, with jute mills, newer factories and growing residential areas. The climate is hot and humid, with a heavy monsoon from June to September. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer in the east. Tell us the size of your play area and the age group of the children. Before you place the order, we send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

richText.heading: Service and spare parts after installation

c: , and the email aftersales@funplaysystems.com with your warranty papers. When you report a problem, send a photo of the part, the name of the equipment and the date of installation. That lets us identify the part quickly.

Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.
